intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is caused by homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the MPV17 gene (137960) on chromosome 2p23.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is caused by homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the MPV17 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: We describe a patient presenting with a severe peripheral neuropathy, leukoencephalopathy and liver involvement due to a homozygous MPV17 gene mutation leading to multiple mtDNA deletions and focal COX deficiency in skeletal muscle.
checks.explanation: The paper describes one patient with a homozygous MPV17 mutation and axonal neuropathy. It does not use the CMT2EE designation and reports no compound heterozygous mutations.

checks.claim: The MPV17 gene is located on chromosome 2p23.
checks.evidence_quote: revealed a homozygous missense variant (c.2898C>T; p.Pro98Leu) in MPV17
checks.explanation: The paper does not give the chromosomal location, but adding a gene's standard locus counts as acceptable nomenclature under the instructions.

paragraphs.text: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE (CMT2EE) is an autosomal recessive axonal sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy. It begins in childhood or later, with distal muscle weakness and atrophy, mainly in the lower limbs, along with distal sensory loss. Some patients have features suggesting mitochondrial dysfunction. Other mutations in MPV17 cause a severe infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome, which includes Navajo neurohepatopathy.

checks.claim: CMT2EE is an autosomal recessive axonal sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy.
checks.evidence_quote: This study enrolled two autosomal recessive Korean families with axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy (FC26 and FC355, Fig. 1a).
checks.explanation: Paper describes AR axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy.

checks.claim: CMT2EE begins in childhood or later.
checks.evidence_quote: MPV17 mutations in juvenile- and adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy.
checks.explanation: Juvenile and adult onset corresponds to onset in childhood or later.

checks.claim: CMT2EE causes distal muscle weakness and atrophy, mainly in the lower limbs.
checks.evidence_quote: Neurologic examination at the age of 34 years revealed muscle weakness and atrophies of bilateral, distal muscles, predominantly in the lower limbs.
he also developed symmetrical distal numbness and subjective coldness in both feet ascending to the knees, and more mildly in his hands.
checks.explanation: The patient had distal sensory loss.

checks.claim: Some patients with CMT2EE have features suggesting mitochondrial dysfunction.
checks.evidence_quote: Significant mitochondrial respiratory chain deficiency was confirmed following sequential COX–SDH histochemistry which identified ∼20% COX-deficient fibres throughout the biopsy, implicating mtDNA involvement
checks.explanation: The patient had ragged-red fibres, COX deficiency, raised CSF lactate and multiple mtDNA deletions.

checks.claim: Other mutations in MPV17 cause a severe infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: mutation of MPV17 - a gene implicated in severe, infantile hepatocerebral mtDNA depletion disorders characterised by a loss of mtDNA copies

checks.claim: The infantile hepatocerebral mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome caused by MPV17 mutations includes Navajo neurohepatopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: Infantile NNH is an early onset, fatal form of hepatocerebral depletion syndrome
checks.explanation: The paper links NNH to the MPV17 p.Arg50Gln founder mutation and describes it as a hepatocerebral depletion syndrome.

paragraphs.text: The transmission pattern of CMT2EE is autosomal recessive.

checks.claim: The transmission pattern of CMT2EE is autosomal recessive.
checks.evidence_quote: This study enrolled two autosomal recessive Korean families with axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy
checks.explanation: AR inheritance with homozygous mutation inherited from each parent.

paragraphs.text: Baumann et al. (2019) found homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in the MPV17 gene in patients with juvenile- or adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy. The mutations included a recurrent arg41-to-gln (R41Q) substitution.

checks.claim: Baumann et al. (2019) found homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in the MPV17 gene in patients with juvenile- or adult-onset axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy.
checks.explanation: The abstract reports only homozygous MPV17 variants ('caused by homozygous MPV17 variants'). No compound heterozygous mutations are described.

checks.claim: The MPV17 mutations found by Baumann et al. (2019) included a recurrent arg41-to-gln (R41Q) substitution.
checks.evidence_quote: Patients of the first family carried the known c.122G>A variant
checks.explanation: The previously reported p.Arg41Gln (R41Q) variant was found again in the first family, so it is recurrent.
